title: MacroPulse Alert
message: Bitget exchange hacked $351.6M (Sep 24 18:31 UTC) — hot/warm wallets drained, withdrawals halted, Lazarus Group suspected. September crypto losses hit $684M 2026-high. BTC stable ~$84,400 (+1.6% 24h), altcoins shrugging off hack (+4.7% CoinDesk 80). 10y yield eased to 5.17% from 5.22% high.
